issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness
issues.problem: tui-demo.sh uses read -r twice; harness subprocess blocks 30s then TimeoutExpired uncaught — run_audit.py exit 1 with no fail row
evidence: data/latest-tui-ui-run/ui-audit.json: tui-app-fixture status fail, baseline_status timeout
ux-harness/adapters/tui.py:33 subprocess.run timeout=30, no stdin injection
printf '\n\n' | tui-demo.sh exits 0 — layout capturable when stdin piped
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — catch TimeoutExpired; pipe stdin for non-TTY
[ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — LI_TUI_NONINTERACTIVE=1 or read from /dev/null
[ ] Test: python3 ux-harness/run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture --mode ui exits 0 with fail row
[ ] Acceptance: harness never crashes uncaught on interactive fixtures

issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-demo.sh UTF-8 em dash mojibake in harness captures

evidence: data/latest-tui-ui-run/captures/tui-app-fixture-piped.txt: Li TUI demo M-bM-^@M-^T press h
tui-demo.sh line 3: em dash in printf string
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — ASCII hyphen or enforce UTF-8 in harness env
[ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — LANG=C.UTF-8 in subprocess env
[ ] Acceptance: capture files readable without mojibake in CI logs
